description: M16-reserved-idle IOB bank XOR delta cells.  Apply when M16 is NOT used in design (Quartus default RESERVE_ALL_UNUSED_PINS=As input tri-stated with weak pull-up).  Verified 2026-05-03 against probe2 silicon-validated reference (md5 d4073d2e..) and 9 simple_led_E16_to_G15_clk{PIN}.rbf discriminators.
semantic: XOR — flips bits regardless of base state.  When M16 unused: applies; when M16 used (cl_and, simple_led_clkM16): MUST NOT apply.
xor_cells_unified_with_iob_pad_nv_recali: Group A — M16-reserved-idle bank delta (24 cells, fires whenever M16 reserved):

Group B — IOB_CLK_INPUT_E1 cells double-flipped by IOB_PAD_NV (9 cells, fires when M16 reserved AND IOB_PAD_NV+IOB_CLK_INPUT_E1 both emitted; corrects calibration mismatch where IOB_PAD_NV embeds M16-active assumption):

Group C — frame-0 + frame-8/9 residual cells closing the last 9 probe2 hdr diffs (2026-05-03; verified open ^ 1 == quartus_probe2 for all; cl_and unaffected since directive gated on M16 reserved). 3 MISS-closers + 6 OVER-closers:

Group D — fabric LAB-column-default + GCLK_PIN_E1 calibration + X=33-area cells, closing 24 of 61 fabric cells. All verified open^1==quartus_probe2 + cl_and uses M16 so directive doesn't fire (byte-identity preserved). 12 LAB-col-default at X<10 (universal across all 10 simple_led discriminators); 7 M16-active-only (cl_and flips via GCLK_PIN_E1/X33Y4_INFRA, probe2 needs un-flip); 5 partial-pattern cells:

applied_to_probe2_open.rbf.remaining_hdr: 3 MISS + 6 OVER, all in offsets 41-74 (frame 0) — likely from OTHER reserved pins (A14/B14/M15/M2/M1/R4/R8/T4)

residual_after_application.interpretation: Frame-0 mixed-reserve cells (depend on clk pin or other reserved pins; not M16-specific). Frame-8 bp=2 are probe2-only (X=33 1-LE + E1 clock + N=4 placement specific) — needs X=33 1-LE Quartus discriminator to mine.

next_session_implementation: 1. Add `IOB_RESERVE_PIN_M16` directive to fuzz/fasm2rbf.py emitting these 24 XOR cells
2. Add auto-emit logic in synth/np2fasm.py: emit when M16 not in design top-level IOBs
3. Optionally generalize to IOB_RESERVE_PIN <PIN> with per-pin tables — needs mining for E16/M15/etc.
4. Mine X=33 1-LE discriminator (1-LE@X=33Y4N4 vs 1-LE@X=10Y10N0 with same E1+E16+G15) to attack the 4 frame-8 bp=2 cells

deeper_finding_2026_05_03.title: IOB_CLK_INPUT vs IOB_PAD_NV data calibration mismatch
deeper_finding_2026_05_03.description: The 4 'probe2-specific' cells (1918-1921, bp=2) and 4 OVERs (1914-1917, bp=3) are NOT actually missing — they are emitted by BOTH `IOB_CLK_INPUT PIN_E1` AND `IOB_PAD_NV` and double-flip-cancel.  However, simply skipping IOB_CLK_INPUT when IOB_PAD_NV is present introduces NEW gaps because IOB_CLK_INPUT also covers cells NOT in IOB_PAD_NV (e.g. (45,0), (50,0), (73,1)).  This is not a pure codec dedup bug — it is a data calibration mismatch.
deeper_finding_2026_05_03.root_cause: IOB_CLK_INPUT was mined assuming IOB_BASELINE_NV (129-cell) baseline (per data file note). When applied on top of IOB_PAD_NV (139-cell, partial overlap), some cells have correct XOR semantics, others have incorrect double-flip. Per-cell decision needed.
clean_fix_options: (a) Re-mine IOB_CLK_INPUT against IOB_PAD_NV baseline. Build Quartus refs at SLICE_X10_Y10_N0 with E16+G15+clkE1 vs E16+G15+clkE15, both placed under IOB_PAD_NV-equivalent topology. Diff = pure E1-vs-E15 delta uncontaminated by IOB_PAD_NV cells. ~2hr Quartus work.

(b) Add a static 'IOB_CLK_INPUT_when_IOB_PAD_NV_present' override list: explicitly list which IOB_CLK_INPUT cells to skip when IOB_PAD_NV is also emitted. Build the list via per-cell analysis (which cells are correctly cancelling vs which are wrongly cancelling). Pure software, no Quartus.
